reduction_law.conditions: Both fixed arms x states800/6400 x D1856/D6400, twelve fixed fit contexts in three B4 batches; all observations retained.
reduction_law.direct_ratio: ||g||/(||c||+||u||); a norm ratio, not an energy-loss fraction.
reduction_law.gate_weighting: Gate statistics use unweighted site/B4 frames; token counts vary by site. These means are not full-model token fractions or Jacobian conditioning certificates.
reduction_law.per_context_vs_batch: Per-context upstream force is zero on the other three contexts. B4 mean separately includes cross-context summation.
reduction_law.selection: No output metrics, context filtering, seed scan, worst-row selection or optimizer intervention.
reduction_law.undefined_denominators: Nulls are retained and counted; no substitution.
reduction_law.verified_decomposition: ||c+u-g||<=1e-12+2e-4*(||c||+||u||); separate BF16 reductions allow numerical tolerance, with no bitwise equality claim.
reduction_law.weighted_halves: c=3*J_cond^T v; u=-2*J_uncond^T v; g=direct actual guided VJP. Cosine compares already CFG-weighted halves.

scope: Read-only reduction of the completed predeclared local CFG-gradient observer; no new training or forwards.
